title: Grokking Onset vs. Modular-Arithmetic Task Parameters

original_idea.body:
# Grokking Onset vs. Modular-Arithmetic Task Parameters

Vary modulus, data fraction, weight decay; produce phase diagrams of grokking onset.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Inductive-bias/grokking is alignment-priority but the chain to a catastrophic outcome is broad/indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny MLPs/transformers on toy data, minutes per run; classic beginner setup.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped one-variable sweep with phase diagrams.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: toy data, public; though grokking is heavily studied.

low_compute.reasoning: Minutes per run on one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Grokking onset vs modulus/weight-decay/data-fraction is heavily charted.
